title: Application Boundaries & Dependency Direction
objectives: Separate UI, application services and domain logic in a Vue app
Spot boundary violations in component code

examples.name: boundaries.ts

exercise.prompt: Mark each import as ALLOWED or VIOLATION for a layered Vue app: "component imports composable", "composable imports api client", "api client imports vue component", "store imports domain logic".
hints: Dependencies must flow toward the domain, never back to the UI.
Infrastructure (api client) sits below services and UI.

options: in the component that renders them
questions.explanation: Components render; rules live below the UI layer where they are testable and reusable.

questions.prompt: A domain module importing a Pinia store is…
questions.explanation: The domain must not know about state frameworks; stores may call the domain, not vice versa.
